title: Selecting by attribute
summary: [data-status="done"], [href^="https"] and [type="email"]: style elements by what they are, not by extra classes.
explanation: Square brackets select by attribute. [data-status="done"] matches an exact value, so the task list is coloured from its data attributes alone and changing the data changes the look.
Operators match parts of a value: ^= starts with, $= ends with, *= contains. [href^="https://"] catches every absolute link, [href$=".pdf"] every PDF.
An attribute selector has the same specificity as a class, so a later class rule can still override it.
tryThis: Change the first task's data-status to done in Items: it turns green and gets struck through.
Add a fourth task with data-status: blocked and write a rule for it.
Change ^= to *= with "example": now any link containing example matches.
